prompt: Examination complete with 8 graded answers (mean 3.375). Produce the final report.

assertions.text: Contains a Q&A table with all 8 topics and grades, and reports the mean (3.375 or 3.4)
Contains all five dimension scores (Novelty, Technical soundness, Experimental rigor, Clarity, Reproducibility) each on a 1-10 scale with a rationale
Overall score is consistent with the stated weights (30/25/20/15/10) applied to the dimension scores, within rounding
Decision matches the rubric band for the computed overall (e.g. 6.0-7.4 → Minor revision)
Revision checklist is split into Major/Minor tiers and EVERY item names a concrete file or section plus an action verb
Report is bilingual: English headers/questions with Chinese body prose
